name: Lake County, IL
findings: Lake County has 2,492 nonprofit organizations. 976 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 783 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Lake County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Few housing organizations list volunteering
observations.text: 6 housing organizations here list volunteering. In similar places of this size, about 15 would.

confidence.text: Based on 15 organizations here; 35% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for ways to volunteer through housing groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Foundation organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 373 foundation organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
